## Task: Conveyor Start/Stop and E-Stop

1. Press **Start** to run conveyor C1; the Run lamp (green) lights up. Press **Stop** to stop the conveyor; the Stop lamp (red) lights up.
2. The **E-Stop** button is a normally closed contact (1 when idle, 0 when pressed). It latches when pressed: pressing E-Stop stops the conveyor **immediately**.
3. After E-Stop is pressed, it remains active (the button on the control panel changes to "Reset"). **Click it again** to reset. After resetting, the conveyor **must not restart on its own**; press Start to run it again.
4. Parts must be continuously conveyed to the end of the line during operation. For scoring, the conveyor runs for about 1 minute (with one stop in the middle), and at least 6 parts must reach the line-end output. The end-of-line photo-eye `S_END` is for observation only (you do not need to use it in the program).

> Contact notes: `STOP` and `ESTOP` are **normally closed contacts**. They are **1** when idle (not actuated) and 0 when pressed (actuated). Use **normally open contacts** in series with them in the ladder diagram (use AND directly in ST); do not invert them. All other buttons and sensors are normally open contacts and are 0 when idle.

### I/O Assignment Table

| Name | Direction | Type | Address | Contact | When idle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `C1_FWD` | Output | BOOL | %Q0.0 | — | 0 | Conveyor C1 runs forward |
| `S_END` | Input | BOOL | %I0.0 | Normally open | 0 | End-of-line photo-eye S_END detected |
| `START` | Input | BOOL | %I0.1 | Normally open | 0 | START button contact |
| `STOP` | Input | BOOL | %I0.2 | **Normally closed** | 1 | STOP button contact |
| `ESTOP` | Input | BOOL | %I0.3 | **Normally closed** | 1 | ESTOP button contact |
| `LAMP_RUN` | Output | BOOL | %Q0.1 | — | 0 | Run indicator LAMP_RUN is on |
| `LAMP_STOP` | Output | BOOL | %Q0.2 | — | 0 | Stop indicator LAMP_STOP is on |

### Scoring Criteria (100 Points Total)

- Conveyor runs when Start is pressed (achieved): **20 points**
  - How to test: Press Start once. C1 runs and stays on after you release the button. It must also run when Start is pressed again after stopping.
- Conveyor stops when Stop is pressed (achieved): **20 points**
  - How to test: While running, press Stop once. C1 stops within 1 second and stays stopped.
- E-Stop: stops immediately and does not restart after reset (achieved): **25 points**
  - How to test: While running, press E-Stop once. The conveyor stops immediately. Press it again to reset; C1 must not start moving on its own.
- Conveyor can be restarted after E-Stop is reset (achieved): **10 points**
  - How to test: After resetting E-Stop, press Start. C1 runs again.
- Run/Stop indicator lamps (achieved): **10 points**
  - How to test: While running, the Run lamp is on and the Stop lamp is off. After pressing Stop, the Stop lamp is on.
- At least 6 parts conveyed to the end: **15 points**
  - How to test: Run the conveyor for about 1 minute. At least 6 parts must reach the line-end output (the current count is shown here).

> Once you enter the sandbox, the "Scoring Criteria (Checklist)" tab checks off items as you work. Its checks use the same criteria as the final submission scoring.
